content: QuPath uses a single project to hold multiple sections as separate entries. Each entry gets a numeric directory under <project>/data/<entryID>/ containing server.json (image URI), data.qpdata (PathObjects), summary.json (counts), and ABBA artifact files. Classifiers and scripts live at the project root in classifiers/ and scripts/ directories. The canonical batch pattern is: write a Groovy script targeting getCurrentImageData(), then use Run > Run for project to apply it to all (or selected) entries sequentially. QuPath auto-saves each entry's imageData to data.qpdata after script completion. A single-project-per-animal layout is the standard; one project holds all sections from that animal.
